senses.gloss:
जैन m. (-नः) A Jaina, a follower of the principles of a Jina or teacher
of heterodox notions, the chief of which are, the supremacy of
certain religious pontiffs over the gods of the Hindus, a denial of
the divine authority of the Vedas, and a disregard of the distinc-
tion of castes.
 E. जिन a Jina, and अण् aff. जिनः देवता अस्य ।
